applicability.equation_scope: only the exact candidate_profile object, including its K-indexed SelectSeedProfile(K,2) graph basis, before uint8 attempt stepping
applicability.forbidden_inference: the repair map is not evidence for the legacy width-sensitive profile, another dense-anchor layout, or another packet mix count

domain.source_seed_derivation: MakeDeterministicSource(K,2,0x6d69783273656564); state is seed xor (K*0xd6e8feb86659fd93) xor (block_bytes*0xa0761d6478bd642f), followed by SplitMix64 words serialized little-endian

selection.selection_rule: for each K, test uint8 construction attempts in ascending order; reject an attempt at its first failing cell in frozen cell order; select the first attempt that byte-recovers at overhead 0 on all eighteen cells
selection.lower_attempt_evidence: retain exactly one first-failure witness for every lower attempt and all eighteen success receipts for the selected attempt

packet_trace.rng: SplitMix64; Unit=(Next() >> 11) / 2^53; drop iff Unit < loss_rate
packet_trace.burst: candidate packet IDs 0,1,...; RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade; eight-drop bursts start on an idle candidate with probability loss_rate/(8-7*loss_rate)
packet_trace.adversarial: candidate packet IDs UINT32_MAX-2*i modulo 2^32; RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade and IID drops
packet_trace.repair-only: candidate packet IDs K+i modulo 2^32; RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade and IID drops
packet_trace.nested_overhead: generate one K+4 delivered-ID prefix; score OH0 from exactly its first K IDs
packet_trace.trace_sha256: SHA-256 of all K+4 delivered IDs encoded consecutively as unsigned 32-bit little-endian words

short_screen.full_derivation_reproduction: exact canonical 30-K derivation records and selected attempt bytes before validation

root_derivation.extraction: first 8 digest bytes interpreted as unsigned big-endian uint64
root_derivation.collision_rule: fail if any root is zero, duplicated, or appears in selection roots; do not retry or substitute

validation.rule: replay exactly the frozen map byte indexed by K-2 on all nine disjoint cells; runtime search, retries, substitutions, and post-hoc map edits are forbidden
validation.gate: zero overhead-0 weak K values and zero unsupported, construction, fatal, internal, or byte-mismatch outcomes

repair_map.encoding: 63999 uint8 attempt values indexed by K-2
repair_map.freeze_rule: SHA-256 the exact 63999 bytes and complete canonical derivation audit before any validation worker starts
repair_map.bundle_chain: the derivation manifest binds an authenticated v7 short-screen PASS; the validation manifest binds the repair-map receipt; that receipt binds the short-screen hashes, derivation manifest, freeze, summary, audit, and map; every self-hash and semantic relationship is rechecked before validation
